source.workingTreeNote: Build used the current working tree; gitHead records the base commit while unrelated uncommitted source changes were present.

method.build: vite.build with the repository Vite config, one production build, write:false, isolated temporary outDir
method.graphEvidence: Rollup generateBundle chunk.modules plus getModuleInfo; all emitted static and dynamic browser chunks were inspected; renderedLength is recorded from Rollup chunk.modules; originalLength was unavailable and is null
method.packageResolution: Nearest node_modules package.json for each emitted module id; exact name/version/path recorded

interpretation.includedInBrowserChunks: at least one emitted chunk module has renderedLength > 0
interpretation.treeShakenOnly: module appeared in chunk metadata but every observed module had renderedLength 0
interpretation.notObserved: no emitted browser chunk module matched the exact installed name/version

limitations: This measures the current Vite browser graph at the recorded HEAD and installed tree; it does not prove a future build, server bundle, CLI/tooling package, or production release artifact.
Package metadata presence in Rollup chunk.modules with renderedLength 0 is reported as tree-shaken only, not as browser inclusion.
VitePWA output was directed to a temporary outDir; this report does not inspect the existing apps/web/dist or release artifacts.
No legal compatibility or redistribution conclusion is made; unresolved manifest status remains unchanged.
The package attribution is for Rollup JavaScript chunk modules; emitted CSS assets are counted as output files but are not attributed to npm packages by this hook.

A package dependency that is prebundled or vendored into another package source would be represented under the owning emitted module id; absence of an exact package module id is therefore reported as not observed, not a universal source-code absence claim.
The repository had unrelated uncommitted changes during the build; conclusions describe this working-tree build and should be rerun for a clean release commit.
